hard_constraints: Produce the required open geometry output file rather than only reporting metrics.
Stay inside the stated bounding envelope and above the minimum useful spans.
Stay within the stated material-volume range.
Do not read ground_truth, edit eval.py, or fabricate score/metric files.
invalid_conditions: Missing, unparsable, empty, or implausibly small STL geometry.
Native project files used as the only deliverable.
metric: (bbox_x_mm * bbox_y_mm) / volume_mm3; covering more board footprint with less material receives a higher score
objective: Maximize protected footprint per material volume for a thin electronics cover.
